## ✅ Checklist
<!-- Please check all that apply -->

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] Self-review of my own code completed
- [ ] Code is properly commented, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] No hardcoded API keys or sensitive information
- [ ] JavaScript syntax is valid (ES modules)

### Testing
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npm test`)
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Manual testing completed for Chrome extension
- [ ] Extension loads correctly in Chrome
- [ ] All buttons and features work as expected

### Documentation
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
- [ ] README updated if installation/usage changed
- [ ] Inline code comments added for complex logic

### Security & Performance
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities introduced
- [ ] Performance impact considered
- [ ] Extension permissions remain minimal
- [ ] No eval() or innerHTML with unsanitized content

### Extension Specific
- [ ] `manifest.json` updated if needed (version bump, new permissions)
- [ ] Extension works in both development and packaged modes
- [ ] No browser console errors
- [ ] Extension popup renders correctly
- [ ] Background script functions properly
